title: Pure Reptilianne
summary: Pure Reptilianne control and Synchro strategy focused on reducing the ATK of opposing monsters to 0 and capitalizing on weakened foes for massive searches, stealing, and board clears. The deck leverages modern support to turn opponent boards into fuel for Reptile Link and Synchro bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Reptilianne Ramifications discards 1 card to search any 2 Reptilianne cards with different names, or search 1 and reduce an opponent's monster's ATK to 0.

Reptilianne Nyami discards itself from hand as a Quick Effect during either turn to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK to 0, and Special Summons itself from the GY while the opponent controls a 0 ATK monster.

Reptilianne Coatl Special Summons itself from the hand while you control a DARK Reptile, and can summon up to that many additional Reptilianne monsters from your hand for every 0 ATK monster the opponent controls.
Reptilianne Lamia reduces an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 to Special Summon itself from the hand, and reduces up to 2 opponent's monsters' ATK to 0 when sent to the GY as Synchro material.

summary.title: Opening: Reptilianne Ramifications + Any Discard
steps: Activate Reptilianne Ramifications, discarding a card to search Reptilianne Nyami and Reptilianne Coatl (or reduce an opponent's monster's ATK to 0).
Normal Summon a Level 4 Reptilianne or summon Reptilianne Nyami, then Special Summon Reptilianne Coatl from your hand.
Link Summon Reptilianne Echidna using both Reptiles, and activate its on-summon effect to reduce an opponent's monster's ATK to 0.
Activate Reptilianne Echidna's second effect to search Reptile monsters from your Deck up to the number of 0 ATK monsters your opponent controls.
Synchro Summon Reptilianne Melusine or Reptilianne Hydra to lock the field or wipe all 0 ATK monsters while drawing cards.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Reptilianne Melusine cannot be destroyed by battle or card effects when summoned using only Reptiles, and reduces an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 whenever they activate a monster effect.
Reptilianne Hydra destroys all 0 ATK monsters your opponent controls on Synchro Summon and draws 1 card for each monster destroyed.
Reptilianne Echidna reduces an opponent's monster's ATK to 0 on Link Summon and searches Reptiles from the Deck equal to the number of 0 ATK monsters on the field.
Reptilianne Vaskii Special Summons itself from the hand by tributing two 0 ATK monsters from anywhere on the field, and destroys 1 face-up monster your opponent controls once per turn.
Reptilianne Viper takes control of an opponent's 0 ATK monster when Normal Summoned.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Reptilianne Recoil is a Field Spell that destroys your own 0 ATK monster to revive a DARK Reptile with different name, and takes control of an opponent's 0 ATK monster when the opponent activates a monster effect.
Reptilianne Spawn banishes a Reptilianne monster from your GY to Special Summon two Reptilianne Tokens, providing instant fodder for Link Summons or Vaskii tributes.
Reptilianne Ramifications serves as the primary search engine and play enabler, searching combo pieces while setting opponent monsters to 0 ATK.
